exposure: delivery type (cesarean section or vaginal delivery)
cohort: Children born via cesarean section or vaginal delivery in Japan were included, with 3363 cases of Kawasaki disease and 13,363 matched controls without KD.
finding: Kawasaki disease onset was associated with cesarean section, the presence of older siblings, lower birth weight (1001-2500 g), and antibiotic use.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with an increased risk of Kawasaki disease onset (OR: 1.12; 95% CI: 1.02-1.24).
